en: One of the most amazing features of Pi,
besides its minimal core,
is its extensibility, which of course kind
of goes together with that minimal core
because it allows you to start
lean, small,
minimal, but then extend Pi and build it
into exactly the kind of coding agent you
want for your day-to-day work. So rather
than getting something someone else built
for you, you get something that you can
tweak and fine-tune for your liking. And you
do this with 2 main
features or mechanisms.
Agent skills, which you may already know, it
exists in other coding agents too. It's very
common, but of course we'll dive into it
again in this course.
And then also extensions, which is a
Pi-specific feature since I'm talking about
Pi extensions here. And of course, we'll
also have a very detailed look at that
feature then.
